dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001135\_39](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001135) Tropical storm during the period Jan 08 2025-Jan 17 2025 in Madagascar, Mozambique, Comoros. The center of the storm was located near latitude -34.61 longitude 58.47. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
